title: Greet the assistant
searchText:
Greet the assistant
hi
Hi! 👋 Good to see you. I saw you linked [[calendar/2026-08-02]] — I can open it if you want to chat about anything in there, but no pressure. What's on your mind today? I can help with: - **Vault work** — organizing notes, ingesting sources, linting the wiki, or exploring what's in your knowledge base - **Research** — dig into a topic using the `/last30days` tool or the wiki - **Anything else** — just say the word What would you like to do?
